$comment: Standing platform test checklist — area ledger. Hand-edited, append-only; validated by scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs (pnpm check:platform-checklist). Authoring rules: docs/qa/platform-checklist/README.md · execution protocol: RUNNER.md.
title: Dashboards, reports, analytics

items.title: A widget authored with a stray/legacy key fails loud, never renders blank
steps: author a dashboard widget carrying a legacy key (e.g. categoryField) or a hallucinated key
load the dashboard / run the parse

acceptance.clause: the parse rejects the widget with a loud error NAMING the offending key and pointing at the dataset shape — the old failure mode (silently renders nothing) must not reproduce
acceptance.verify: the error names the key and cites the expected dataset+dimensions+values shape (ADR-0021)

negative: this item IS a negative test — its pass condition is the rejection; a blank-but-no-error render is a FAIL
source: #3358 §3 (four stray-key variants all rejected with the named error)

items.title: Charts draw on first paint — no blank-until-resize
steps: cold-load a dashboard with bar charts
screenshot immediately after render settles, WITHOUT resizing the window

acceptance.clause: bars/axes are drawn on the first paint
acceptance.verify: the first-paint screenshot shows a real chart (recharts SVG with bars), not an empty plot area

source: #3358 §3 — note its caveat: with thin seeds every widget draws one data point, so the tick 'says less than it looks'; prefer multi-bucket fixtures

history.change: initial import from #3358 with the thin-seed caveat attached

items.title: Report drill-through scopes the drilled list to the exact bucket range

requires: a date-bucketed report with MULTIPLE buckets to drill (blocked historically by #3415 — seed validation silently rejected 4 of 5 projects, leaving single-point charts)

steps: drill a date-bucket cell (e.g. a quarter)

acceptance.clause: the drilled list is scoped to exactly that time range — not a superset
acceptance.verify: the drill request carries the bucket's from/to bounds and the row count matches the bucket's aggregate

history.change: initial import from #3358; runnable once multi-bucket seeds exist
